_meta.command: claude --bg --allowedTools "Bash(echo *)" Agent SendMessage TeamCreate TeamDelete --name <slug>-probe-sonnet --model sonnet --settings <dump-hook.json> "<prompt: 1) echo bg-main-probe, 2) Agent bez name (general-purpose): echo bg-subagent-probe, 3) teammate Agent Teams name=probe: echo bg-teammate-probe>"
_meta.note: Payload przechwycony hookiem PreToolUse (matcher Bash) z --settings, ktory zapisywal stdin 1:1 do pliku; CLAUDE_CODE_EXPERIMENTAL_AGENT_TEAMS=1 w srodowisku. Zwykly subagent (Agent bez name) w tej samej sesji --bg: agent_id + agent_type = typ agenta (general-purpose), session_id jak lider.
_meta.anonymized: sciezka domowa /Users/<login> -> /Users/USER; reszta payloadu bez zmian
